AuthorisationResult.name: Authorisation Result
AuthorisationResult.definition: Outcome of the authorisation, and actions to perform.

AllowedProductCode.name: Allowed Product Code
AllowedProductCode.definition: Product code which are allowed by the payment card.

NotAllowedProductCode.name: Not Allowed Product Code
NotAllowedProductCode.definition: Product code not allowed by the payment card.

AdditionalAvailableProduct.name: Additional Available Product
AdditionalAvailableProduct.definition: Products that may be added to the purchase after the authorisation.

Balance.name: Balance
Balance.definition: Balance and currency code of the account, related to the payment.

Action.name: Action
Action.definition: Set of actions to be performed by the POI (Point Of Interaction) system.

CurrencyConversionEligibility.name: Currency Conversion Eligibility
CurrencyConversionEligibility.definition: Conversion between the currency of a card acceptor and the currency of a card issuer, provided by a dedicated service provider. The currency conversion has to be proposed to the cardholder.
